title_ru: Классификация образовательных исходов студентов и анализ академических профилей
title_en: Student Outcome Classification and Academic Profile Analysis
research_question_ru: Как меняется качество классификации исхода обучения при добавлении результатов первого и второго семестров?

dataset.name: Predict Students' Dropout and Academic Success

feature_ablation_plan.interpretation: Historical comparison of available feature groups; prospective prediction at a specific date is not established by this dataset.
feature_ablation_plan.exclusion_reason: The individual observation date of these financial statuses is not established; any extension using them must be reported separately.

evaluation_plan.split: One shared stratified 70/15/15 train/validation/test partition; save row membership before modelling.
evaluation_plan.cross_validation: Stratified 5-fold cross-validation within the training partition for at least one supervised model.
evaluation_plan.selection_data: Training cross-validation and validation only; no test-based tuning.
evaluation_plan.preprocessing: Fit encoders, scalers, imputation, feature selection and any modelling PCA on training data or on the training part of each CV fold only.
evaluation_plan.imbalance_plan: Evaluate the original distribution; consider class weights using training/validation data. No SMOTE or ADASYN.
evaluation_plan.test_status: Evaluated after freezing the declared plan; repeated unchanged for reproducibility; no post-test selection or retuning.

modelling_plan.lecture_note: Select at least two algorithms covered in the team's actual lectures.
modelling_plan.ann: Feedforward multiclass ANN with training/validation history; architecture and training settings to be justified before fitting.
modelling_plan.clustering: K-Means on selected scaled quantitative academic features; choose parameters on training data; Target excluded from fitting and selection.
modelling_plan.pca: Training-fitted exploratory PCA on appropriate quantitative features with explained variance and retained component count.
